name: Cisco ASA — VPN Login From ≥2 Distinct IPs for Same User
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "113039"
| filter xdm.source.user.username != null and xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| fields xdm.source.user.username as vpn_user, xdm.source.ipv4 as first_ip,
         xdm.source.location.country as first_country, _time as first_time
| join type = inner (
    datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "113039"
    | filter xdm.source.user.username != null and xdm.source.ipv4 != null
    | fields xdm.source.user.username as user2, xdm.source.ipv4 as second_ip,
             xdm.source.location.country as second_country, _time as second_time) as b
  b.user2 = vpn_user
| filter second_time > first_time
     and timestamp_diff(second_time, first_time, "MINUTE") <= 30
     and first_country != second_country
| comp count() as pairs, values(first_ip) as first_ips, values(second_ip) as second_ips,
       values(first_country) as first_countries, values(second_country) as second_countries,
       min(first_time) as first_seen, max(second_time) as last_seen by vpn_user
| alter remote_ip = arrayindex(second_ips, 0)
| fields vpn_user, remote_ip, first_ips, second_ips, first_countries, second_countries,
         pairs, first_seen, last_seen
description: ASA 113039 AnyConnect parent session starts for the same user from two different countries within 30 minutes: impossible travel via VPN.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — VPN Login From ≥2 Distinct IPs for Same User
alert_description:
What fired: ASA 113039 AnyConnect parent session starts for the same user from two different countries within 30 minutes: impossible travel via VPN.

Why it matters: an actor may be gaining an initial foothold (phishing, exploit, or valid accounts). Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1078 - Valid Accounts (TA0001 - Initial Access).

Investigate:
  - Identify the entry vector, the targeted user/asset, and the source.
  - Check for successful access and any follow-on execution or persistence from the same actor.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (vpn_user) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
